selection_origin: Top two result-independent candidates in semantic_novelty_audit_paper/TMLR_UPGRADE_PLAN.md that pass availability screening and provide materially different semantic representations.
selection_rule: In the prespecified priority order CLUTRR, DeepMind Mathematics, Karel, NoRA, include the first two candidates that have a public generator or immutable data split, an executable semantic representation, a redistributable research license, and either feasible retraining or per-item behavioral artifacts.
historical_cases_excluded: In-Context Occam's Razor Markov and regression testbeds

candidates.title: CLUTRR: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Inductive Reasoning from Text
candidates.audited_claim: The inductive CLUTRR setting evaluates systematic generalization to held-out combinations of logical kinship rules rather than reuse of training relation patterns.
availability_evidence: Public deterministic dataset generator with train/test task and holdout controls.
Rules and relations are stored explicitly.
The public format can retain complete puzzles and proof information.
Two public baseline repositories expose training and per-item generation/evaluation paths.
candidates.behavioral_feasibility: Use a frozen lightweight reference Transformer trained on paired Original and Strict streams generated from the same official source revision. The local implementation and all manifests must be hashed before any training.
candidates.planned_semantic_scope: Canonical kinship-rule composition after entity alpha-renaming and proof-order normalization; the exact signature and verifier are frozen in the full preregistration before any census.
candidates.result_independent_inclusion_reason: First candidate in the prespecified order; public generator, exact rule metadata, held-out-pattern claim, and feasible paired retraining all pass availability screening.

candidates.title: Analysing Mathematical Reasoning Abilities of Neural Models
candidates.dataset_revision: Version 1.0 pre-generated train-easy/train-medium/train-hard and interpolate/extrapolate files, or deterministic regeneration from the pinned code revision; exact source choice must be frozen before extraction.
candidates.audited_claim: The generated interpolation and extrapolation splits measure mathematical generalization beyond surface question identity and curriculum difficulty.
availability_evidence: Public generator with module-level filters and declared dependencies.
Version 1.0 provides two million question-answer pairs per module.
Separate curriculum training and interpolate/extrapolate test splits are public.
SymPy-backed generators provide executable mathematical objects for selected modules.
candidates.behavioral_feasibility: No public checkpoint is required for the registered suite gate; a behavioral experiment is forbidden from replacing the CLUTRR primary endpoint unless a new protocol version is frozen before inspecting Mathematics overlap.
candidates.planned_semantic_scope: A result-independent subset of modules with deterministic parser-backed canonical mathematical objects; module list and verifier must be frozen in the full preregistration before any census.
candidates.result_independent_inclusion_reason: Second candidate in the prespecified order; it passes availability screening and supplies a semantic domain materially different from kinship-rule composition.
